notes: litert-community/LFM3-1.7B-LiteRT: LFM3-1.7B_int8_ekv2048.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM generic_model conversion of LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B at revision 40ebe0aa (LFM Open License v1.0): a hybrid decoder (13 short-convolution, 6 global-attention and 5 sliding-window layers), text in, text out; it thinks in a <think> block by default (enable_thinking switches it off); tool calls come back as XML text (no LiteRT-LM parser reads them). One conversation per Engine (a new conversation on a used Engine continues from the last one's convolution state). Pixel 8a (phone 4C131JEKB15210) rows: holds p5, p8 of run r8 on 2026-10-29 JST, reboot none (uptime per run). The benchmark = two processes of the published file in one hold; the 8 questions = one process each. The CPU benchmark of this file was not run (the card: on a CPU, use a mixed int4 file). quantization: every fully connected weight, the tied lm_head and the embedding table int8 channelwise (dynamic_wi8_afp32: the CPU quantizes activations to int8 at run time); no activation type declared (the GPU runs float16 activations by default); sampler TOP_P k 50 / p 1 / temperature 0.1; KV cache 2,048 tokens
